text_block_list.text:
—March. A traditional Tracen Academy 
event. The spring farewell party, "Ligne 
Droite."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ha!

As a special treat, a fencing match 
between Durandal and Fine Motion will be 
held tonight.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If I remain a knight lacking in grace— I 
won't stand a chance in the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Today, I must overcome my weakness no 
matter what. And hopefully—achieve 
victory.

Full of drive. Durandal's run in the 
Twinkle Series was going rather smoothly. 
Meanwhile...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer, good day to you! Is this a 
courtesy call? Or perhaps scouting the 
competition?

Neither of those was the reason I came 
before the race. What I wanted to say in a 
few words was...
choice_data_list: It was tough this spring, wasn't it, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, about that... It can't be helped, a 
lot happens in the Twinkle Series, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Time to reset and refocus for the fall♪ 
Don't worry, today's duel is still on.

Due to some concerns with Fine Motion's 
legs, it was decided to pass on entering 
races this spring.

Her comeback is slated for autumn. Even 
so, the gifted princess is sure to deliver 
a brilliant resurrection.
And at last—the night of the duel.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text: Well then, let the fencing duel begin!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
"Both competitors, step forward! This 
match will be conducted using safe 
imitation rapiers."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-san, today I'd like to check the 
answer as to why I can't seem to be 
elegant."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll make sure it gets across. 
So—give me everything you've got!

A fully confident Fine Motion. What is her 
answer? And can Durandal surpass her?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text: Then let the match begin! Allez!

With a resounding call, the serious duel 
between royalty and knight began.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Now, welcome, Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(The princess is keeping her distance to 
watch and wait. Observing carefully might 
be the royal road to take here.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(However! But! At this rate! It won't be 
enough to please the King!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(No matter what, I must lead the charge 
and bring back glory.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A preemptive strike is the only way! 
Hyaaaah!!

Durandal was the first to make a move. 
Setting the pace with a sharp, piercing 
charge—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I've got you! Fifth Sword: Turpin's 
Charge!
(Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: What?! She dodged it?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Why... did my all-out strike, imbued with 
my vow to the King, fail...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing... There really does seem to 
be incredible potential sleeping deep 
within her heart. But...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As things stand right now, victory belongs 
to me. No matter how much potential you 
hold hidden inside.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "That can't be! Tah! Hah! Yaaaaah!"
(Clang! Clang! Clang!)

A barrage of high-speed strikes was 
deflected time and time again. As if she 
knew exactly where they were coming from.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Now then, it's my turn.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Hup!

"Conversely, the sword thrust by Fine 
Motion easily grazed the tip of Durandal's 
cheek. That was dangerously close..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No way... With a sword that barely has any 
power behind it...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, what is being tested—is my devotion 
to the King! If I truly am a knight... 
Haaah!
(Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thought so. It's the other way 
around, Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Backwards...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes. Your weakness is, well—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: An overwhelming "devotion to the King."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"On the contrary, that very feeling is 
what's preventing you from becoming a 
proper knight."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
M-My feelings for the King... are my 
weakness...? What nonsense...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A knight only exists because of their 
King. To think the King's presence could 
ever be an obstacle...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
These are not mere ravings. You were 
always searching for your King. You 
searched and searched... and finally found 
him.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It was great that I managed to enter their 
service. My motivation shot right up, too. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As if to seal away those feelings, she 
suffered a leg issue and stumbled right at 
the start of her Make Debut...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As a result of so many fortunes and 
misfortunes piling up... Durandal, the way 
you are right now is far too—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Aren't you rushing things a bit too much?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —Eh!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Am I... too eager for success? 
Success...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (Now that... you mention it...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Ugh, impossible... To think it 
would end like this...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"This wasn't... supposed to happen! How 
could this..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(That might... be true... I was just happy 
to be useful, and I wanted to be praised, 
even just a little...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(And more than anything... I didn't want 
to disappoint them...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Durandal, in a duel, one's inner weakness 
will always reveal itself...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"You're always in such a rush to win. To 
elevate the King, to earn the King's 
praise. But..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"The knights I know are never impatient 
for glory. That is because—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because I know that to achieve great 
results, one must wait.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I won't rush things. Even if I can't run 
in any races this spring..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because I know that patiently waiting 
right now is so that I can bring joy to my 
compatriots and fans this autumn.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What about you? Since it is for your king, 
can you be patient and wait without 
rushing for glory?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It is precisely those pent-up feelings 
that will lead to a decisive, 
match-winning blow."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Don't rush to make a mark... just wait... 
I... I...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't do it... I probably won't be 
able to... Because...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Because I am not a true knight. Fine-san, 
not like you, or the knights that you 
know...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I don't possess the courage to just sit 
and wait... In the end, it's nothing more 
than makeshift...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No. I'm sure you can do it. If you put 
your mind to it, you can definitely do it 
too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal." That is—the name of the holy 
sword from French legend.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In the past, marriages between the royal 
families of France and Scotland were 
frequently arranged...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Crossing swords with you today, I felt it 
from the pressure of your blade. You have—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Royal blood flows through her veins! The 
legitimate bloodline descended from the 
Scottish royal family.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: The orthodox—bloodline...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Feel it―― And then――awaken."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The sorrowful Black Dinner. Lord Darnley, 
cut down in his youth. Your blood—surely 
it remembers.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Memories... of royalty... Blood... of 
royalty...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Or... if that truly does flow within me 
as well...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I do not understand. However, the 
Princess has said so. That pride of 
hers...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(If only I could feel it deeper within my 
body. If only I could draw it out. I――I 
could do so much more――!)
(Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! It's much sharper than before. And 
what's more...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Your eyes... have calmed down now♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It is true that I grew impatient. 
Impatient, and cast aside my pride as a 
knight of my own accord. However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I won't—rush my victory anymore.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Calm your mind, focus your eyes, identify 
the critical moment, and then—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I will win for my King. Here I 
go—Princess."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Come forth, my knight.
choice_data_list: Go, Durandal! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!

After a long exchange of words, three, 
then four clashes of swords ring out.

"From that point, it was an evenly matched 
contest, but in the end, Fine Motion 
claimed victory by a narrow margin."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Princess, my deepest gratitude 
for your profound teachings. Though I fell 
short today—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'll become a much more 
respectable version of myself and stand 
before you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm looking forward to it. So, until 
that day comes...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Try not to brood too much. And keep your 
desires in moderation, too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Yes, I'll... exercise 
self-restraint.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Good work today, Trainer. See you next at 
the race.

And so, Durandal became conscious of her 
own bloodline and acquired the means to 
curb her impatience—

Fine Motion and I promised each other that 
our next duel would take place in a race.
